moments.title: Jethro Tull's Ian Anderson turns 79
moments.blurb: Flute-playing frontman of progressive rock legends Jethro Tull, Ian Anderson, celebrates his 79th birthday today.

angles.name: Progressive Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 79th birthday to Jethro Tull's inimitable frontman, Ian Anderson! Still rocking that flute, still a legend.

angles.name: Flute Virtuoso
angles.copy: He made the flute a rock instrument! Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull celebrates his 79th today. What's your favourite Jethro Tull track?

moments.title: New Edition's Michael Bivins turns 58
moments.blurb: Michael Bivins, founding member of New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, and a key figure in R&B and hip-hop, is 58 today.

angles.name: R&B/Hip-Hop Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 58th to Michael Bivins! From New Edition to Bell Biv DeVoe, he's given us so many classics. Which is your favourite?

angles.name: Bell Biv DeVoe throwback
angles.copy: Poison! That's the sound of Michael Bivins, celebrating his 58th birthday today. What a career!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 20th consecutive week, setting a new record.

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: 20 weeks at number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is still dominating the UK Singles Chart. Can anyone stop them?

angles.name: Longest Reign
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just keeps on going at UK No.1. What a track!

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Academy face Sale FC
moments.blurb: Exeter Chiefs Academy are set for an away fixture against Sale FC on Friday, August 14th at 13:00.

angles.name: Local Rugby Action
angles.copy: Good luck to the Exeter Chiefs Academy as they head north to take on Sale FC this Friday! Future stars in the making. #ExeterChiefs

angles.name: Academy Game Day
angles.copy: Friday is game day for the Exeter Chiefs Academy! They face Sale FC away at 1pm. Get behind the next generation of Chiefs!

moments.title: BBC Cymru Wales to broadcast Welsh football
moments.blurb: BBC Cymru Wales has secured a new three-year deal with the FAW to broadcast at least 20 live Novira Cymru Premier matches per season on BBC iPlayer, starting with Barry Town United vs Cardiff Met on August 15th.

angles.name: Big News for Welsh Football
angles.copy: Massive news for Welsh football fans! BBC Cymru Wales is bringing live Novira Cymru Premier action to iPlayer. First up: Barry Town United vs Cardiff Met this Saturday!

angles.name: Tune into Cymru Premier
angles.copy: Get ready for more Welsh domestic football! The Novira Cymru Premier kicks off its new BBC iPlayer deal this Saturday. Who are you backing?

moments.title: The Hundred 2026 Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament culminates this Sunday, August 16th, with Finals Day at Lord's, hosting both the men's and women's finals.

angles.name: Cricket Finals Weekend
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Hundred 2026 Finals Day is this Sunday at Lord's. Who will lift the trophy?

angles.name: Lord's Hosts Finals
angles.copy: The biggest day in The Hundred calendar! Both men's and women's finals are at Lord's this Sunday. Don't miss the action!

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield will take place this Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup holders Manchester City.

angles.name: Football Season Opener
angles.copy: The curtain-raiser for the new football season! Arsenal vs Man City in the Community Shield this Sunday, live from Cardiff!

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage for the Community Shield this Sunday! Who's heading to Principality Stadium to see Arsenal take on Man City?

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Friday, August 16th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen of Pop
angles.copy: No one does it like Madonna! Celebrating her 68th birthday this Friday. What's your ultimate Madonna track?

angles.name: Iconic Madonna
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has consistently reinvented herself. Happy 68th to a true icon this Friday!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68

angles.name: Heaven Is A Birthday

angles.name: Go-Go's and Solo Star
angles.copy: From The Go-Go's to a hugely successful solo career, Belinda Carlisle has given us so many hits. Wishing her a very happy 68th this Saturday!

angles.name: Another One Bites The Dust
angles.copy: 'Another One Bites The Dust' was all him! Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to Queen's John Deacon this Monday.

moments.title: Deep Purple's Ian Gillan turns 81

angles.name: Smoke On The Water
angles.copy: From 'Smoke on the Water' to 'Child in Time', Ian Gillan's vocals defined an era. Wishing him a very happy 81st this Monday!

moments.title: Led Zeppelin's Robert Plant turns 78

angles.copy: The ultimate summer send-off! Reading & Leeds Festivals promise huge headliners and unforgettable sets from August 28th.

angles.name: August Sky Show
angles.copy: August is a blockbuster month for skywatching with the Perseids. Get ready to spot some shooting stars!
